node.title: Rate-half MCA support-local transversality compiler
node.closure: field-general theta compiler and exact fixed-core margins
node.statement: For a same-support pair-noncontained RS MCA family of explanation affine rank s, the exact actual-support margin theta gives the two-endpoint ordered-basis cap printed in the node statement. Pair noncontainment guarantees theta>=1. On complete shortened KoalaBear rows this pays full rank through s=9; at s=10,11,12,13 the least paying margins are 4,49,757,11748, yielding exact direction-exception terminals 3,48,756,11747.
